name: The Evil Eye of Blightseep...
desc:
An entity formed by the continuous accumulation of Abyssal powers which will continuously attack living beings nearby.
Use the ability of the Spirebloom to engage in deflecting counterattack(s) and clear it more quickly.

imgDesc.text:
An entity formed by the continuous accumulation of Abyssal powers which will continuously attack living beings nearby.
Use the ability of the Spirebloom to engage in
deflecting counterattack(s) and clear it more quickly.

Even if you face multiple Evil Eyes, as long as you
release your attack at the right time, you can unleash
deflecting counterattacks to clear them all.
